method: Exact same-Unicode complete cells and outer-zero-margin trim. No scaling, smoothing, simplification, clipped ink, or Unicode substitution. Unmapped records excluded from denominators, not treated as mismatches.

scope.qualification: 216 refers to IDs with at least some comparable mapped Han, not every record mapped. Sample screen is not complete-font verification. History includes removed references and is not identical to the current catalog.

limitation: Low exact overlap does not establish original authorship, manual design, independent lineage, or redistribution rights. No full font, bitmap arrays, or firmware included.
